title: LGR Oddware - Danmere Backer VHS Hard Drive Backup System
summary: LGR reviews the Danmere Backer16, a 1996 backup system that stored a PC's data on ordinary VHS tapes through a VCR. He shows the hardware and software on Windows 3.1 and 95.
why: HN links it whenever data-on-video-tape or YouTube-as-storage schemes come up, as the real precedent for storing digital data on VHS.

quote.text: LGR made a video for one of them, also showing the interface (as in: hardware and GUI) for the backup
